changelog: Say "insert date" — or "তারিখ দাও" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and today's date is inserted in the dictation language ("20 November 2026" in English, "২০ নভেম্বর ২০২৬" in Bengali). Say "insert time" / "সময় দাও" and the current time goes in ("5:50 PM" / "৫:৫০ PM"). Gboard has no date/time voice command, so dating or timestamping a message used to need a reach for the keyboard. The date or time is inserted like any dictated text, so it can be undone, cleared or read back like the rest of the message. Saying the words inside a longer sentence still types them as normal text.
